sources.text:
# Veyl Catalyst

## Overview

The fluid enables the creation of green interdimensional portals, allowing matter to travel almost instantaneously between distant locations and alternate dimensions. Veyran's Rift Weaving can use these portals for both travel within a universe and travel between.

## Properties

The exact chemical composition of Veyl Catalyst has never been fully revealed. In Koselo Zudelu, Talen states that Veyran obtains rare glowing green crystals used in connection with his Veyl Catalyst. The substance requires considerable precision to produce correctly.

Veyl Catalyst is extremely dangerous when improperly manufactured or contaminated. Unlicensed Veyl Catalyst exists on Concord Spire, but an incorrectly calculated mixture can produce unstable or lethal portals.

In Korizu Valura, a Veyran attempts to escape Concord Spire through a portal generated using bootleg fluid. Upon entering the portal, he is disintegrated. Tetene Luriko subsequently concludes that the Veyran's calculations for the Veyl Catalyst were incorrect.

## Characteristics

Large quantities of Veyl Catalyst can behave destructively outside of a Rift Spindle. The substance has been depicted dissolving solid material, while spilled fluid can create portal-like openings on surfaces.

Because of these properties, Veyl Catalyst functions as both the fuel and essential medium for Veyran's interdimensional Rift Weaving, rather than simply serving as a conventional energy source.

sources.text:
# Nested Realm Cell

## Description

The Nested Realm Cell contains a miniature universe with a planet inhabited by intelligent life. These lifeforms use kinetic devices, which were given to them by Veyran, to produce electricity. Under the guise of "waste power", a majority of the energy produced is extracted by Veyran to power his ship. The people of this world, including their president, Demilo, consider Veyran to be a benevolent alien, when in fact, he is using them as slaves. Trouble occurs when a scientist in this miniature world, Nezuko Delomi, invents his own Nested Realm Cell (which he calls a 'Lesser Realm') to provide his people with energy, thus making the kinetic devices Veyran installed obsolete.

## Construction

Inner Realm - made by Veyran; energy extraction via Kinetic Pads Lesser Realm - made by Nezuko Delomi; energy extraction via Orbital Crank Seed Realm - made by Vinese Notemi; planned energy extraction via Tidal Lever

Veyran describes creating a "spatially tessellated void inside a modified temporal field", while Nezuko Delomi describes his Lesser Realm as an "unbounded vacuum inside a temporal field". The temporal fields of the Lesser Realm and Seed Realm are known to speed up time inside the universes relative to the outside, but this is unclear in the case of the Inner Realm; hours pass for Neris in the car while Veyran and Talen are inside the battery, but enough time apparently passes immediately after their escape for the Inner Realm to go back to Kinetic Pads. The speed of time is at least slow enough for President Demilo to have previously met Veyran personally.

Nezuko Delomi states that 80% of the energy made by the inhabitants of his Lesser Realm is extracted for his use, while Veyran does not state precisely how much of the Inner Realm's energy is extracted saying only that 'some of it' powers his ship. The Television broadcast in the Inner Realm world suggests that he is extracting about two thirds of the energy generated.

sources.text:
# Prism Arcade

## History

Prism Arcade is an arcade themed building where Talen plays a virtual reality game called Risese Rirade, where he lives through the entire life of a man named Lutevi Zukoko up to the age of 55.

When Talen returned, he was furious at Veyran for selling a gun to the assassin Nerok Tal for a single afternoon at Prism Arcade. Veyran didn't care for what Talen had to say and proceeded to take his turn in Risese Rirade.

In the commercial an alien can be seen getting teleported into a game and getting shot and another alien can be seen getting decapitated.

In Vavimi Fasami, there are Minovi Luvalo machines located all over the various dimensions. Here you can buy Talens using Lomimi Serasa.

## Location

It is unknown where Prism Arcade is, but the ceiling window shows that it's in space rather than on a planet. The events of Lonemi Sefavi also suggest that it is somewhat near a Fazumi Videne and the garage in which Talen first meets Nerok Tal.

sources.text:
# Vhalan Compact

## Overview

The Vhalan Compact was a major galactic organization which controlled significant areas of the universe until it was dismantled by Veyran in Ludese Virine. There was a surviving part of the militia, seemingly run by Sera Vael until her death in Faneko Viteri.

## History

The Compact government was founded and ruled by the bug-like Yavari, although it includes members of many other species.

Veyran Kest, Avor Kel, and Zorvik are known to be rebels against the organization, fighting numerous battles to free various planets from its control and committing many "atrocities" against it in the process.

It's also revealed that Sera, along with her supposed parents, were undercover agents for the Vhalan Compact in order to catch the rebels affiliated with Avor Kel and Veyran.

The Vhalan Compact falls into anarchy in Ludese Virine once its currency becomes worthless. It does not appear to be in any position to rebuild.

## Galactic Forces

The military branch of the Vhalan Compact is referred to as the Compact Guard, and is shown to be primarily comprised of Yavarian soldiers. Other Compact security forces, which may be part of the same organization, include prison guards and Tedene Lodemi agents. it's shown that the previously presumed-dead Avor Kel has been converted by Sera into a cybernetically-enhanced galactic enforcer.

Some individual member-worlds of the Vhalan Compact have their own native police forces, such as Kavora.

The Compact has been shown to possess guarded security checkpoints, including one on Velora shown at the end of Zusese Zuvimi as well as control over the galaxy's Tedene Lodemi as shown in the Rinofa Serase.

The currency of the Compact is Ralozu Rirazu, although they appear to simply be called "Compact Credits" on Velora. Upon the Voss's return to Velora in Zusese Zuvimi a passing Compact robot offers Daren Voss complimentary antidepressant pills then directs him to the Labor Office where he will be assigned a job to work off his 7,000 credit debt. All Compact jobs on Velora appear to pay only pills.

The Vhalan Compact runs on its own calendar, which appears to be much faster at roughly 2.6 Compact years to one Velora year. Using a Compact year as VCY and an Velora year as VY, the approximate number of VCYs to 1 VY can be calculated using Neris and Talen's respective ages:

Using this method we receive two different answers. As Talen and Neris are not exactly 14 and 17, these results will be slightly off.

sources.title: Avor Kel
sources.text:
He explains to Talen that leaving Veyran was a "dick move", and that Veyran really does care about him. Furthermore, if it wasn't for Veyran, he [Avor Kel] would be dead and would never have met Talen. He then recharges the Rift Spindle and sends Talen back to Veyran.

In "Videlu Safalo," it can be noted that Avor Kel and Veyran have been acquainted for years, as there are many picture frames containing Veyran on his wall. During Avor Kel's early adulthood, he, Veyran and Zorvik formed a band called "Sefane Losemi", where Avor Kel was featured as the main singer. Avor Kel can also be seen beside a younger Veyran, and some sort of aircraft.

In "Loneri Deriri", he and Sera get married and have a huge wedding party. During this time, he confessed to Selra that he and Veyran are wanted by the Vhalan Compact for committing "crimes in the name of freedom" which Selra shrugs off. Shortly after, during the reception, Sera reveals herself to be a member of the Vhalan Compact's secret service and shoots Avor Kel multiple times, followed by a shootout with the rest of the criminals in the room.

## Avor Ember

Sera and the Yavari resurrected Avor Kel as a cyborg and renamed him Avor Ember. Although Sera wanted his name to be Avor Alloy, she didn't push hard enough to make that official. She settled on Avor Ember and took off with him.

sources.title: Avor Kel
sources.text:
## Biography

Veyran-N-482 and Memory Veyran eavesdrop on a meeting between Dawn Vanguard fighters where a Vhaloran says, "Some of us still have home planets to protect," to which Avor Kel responds, "And some of us do not. We need to fight. The impassive is incapable of mercy." Altogether, this seems to imply that Avor Kel's home planet was destroyed by the Compact (likely via the infection shown that causes glowing red eyes and a loss of reason in Kelari), which is why he joined the Dawn Wardens.

He is also one of the very few party-goers who remains behind to help clean up, although he may have just been waiting for Sera to be ready to leave.

When Talen shows his frustration at the party's mess as it would mean no more adventures with Veyran if his parents see the house in this state, Avor Kel informs Talen that "Nava Kora Ven" means "I am in great pain, please help me" in his native language. Talen is skeptical that Veyran actually means this, though this knowledge spurs him to eventually press Veyran into action to preserve their ability to go on adventures together.

sources.title: Velvet Expanse
sources.text:
## Description

Velvet Expanse is accessed by drawing an entranceway with what appears to be a glowing purple piece of chalk.

The inside of Velvet Expanse consists of a massive area that includes mountains, forests, swamps, and likely other biomes. The weather is always perfectly sunny and warm with procedurally generated clouds rolling across the sky. A rainbow river with a stunning waterfall cuts through the land. The ecosystems are largely fantasy inspired as there are literal swamps of honey. Veyran comments that the native wildlife has imaginary, procedurally-generated carbon DNA.

Velvet Expanse was designed by Veyran to be an incredibly safe place for Selra to play in. All ground surfaces are bouncy to prevent injuries from falling, the rainbow river's water is breathable to prevent drowning, and all velvet creatures were designed to be harmless. However, after Mirano got trapped in Velvet Expanse and started mating with the velvet creatures, the Averan DNA gummed up their bio-carbons, mutating them, causing them to develop aggressiveness and predatory attributes.

# Velvet Expanse

## Overview

Velvet Expanse is an artificially generated world created by Veyran Kest from a collapsed quantum tesseract some time in the 1980s for his daughter, Selra Voss, when she was a little girl. It appears in "Rakolu Lunone".

Veyran outright admits that his reason for creating Velvet Expanse was to sequester Selra, who clearly showed strong psychotic tendencies as a child, and protect their neighborhood (though he immediately makes it clear that he didn't do so out of the non-existent goodness of his heart, but just so he wouldn't have to clean up any of Selra's messes). Veyran mentioned that all other Veyrans also made a Velvet Expanse for their Selras.

sources.text:
# Somatic Enclave

## Vesira Grove

"Vesira Grove" was a forest-themed attraction located in Loneva Sanose's lungs. Talen, Dr. Sorin and his crew tried to escape Seride Vasezu by going through the Vesira Grove. They were soon attacked by escaped Loralo Kofafa, and Parek's wild shooting resulted in Nofara Mivavi's death by Loneva Sanose's coughing.

## Gate of Remembrance

The "Gate of Remembrance" is a memorial dedicated to Loneva Sanose's removed appendix. What used to be the entrance to the appendix is framed by stones with flowers and candles placed before it.

## Amber Falls

"Amber Falls" was located in the Lower Basin-part of Somatic Enclave. It was a waterland, presumably filled with urine instead of water.

## Crown Carousel

"Crown Carousel" was a carousel located in Loneva Sanose's brain. Visitors would have to use the Ivory Rail to travel between it and the rest of the park. It was still under construction and the carousel was placed next to Amber Falls at the entrance of the park. Visitors would sit in green bean-like carriages.

## Lower Canal Ride

The "Lower Canal Ride" was an attraction where the visitor would sit in a poop-shaped log and travel down through Loneva Sanose's colon.

## Harmonic Bounce House

sources.text:
# Rift Spindle

## Overview

The Rift Spindle is a gadget that allows the user(s) to travel between different dimensions and locations within one dimension.

## Background

The Rift Spindle was first created by Veyran Oris. After leaving his reality, Oris began visiting his alternate selves and gifted them the technology. When he came to Reality N-482, his counterpart rejected the offer. Insulted, Oris sent a bomb to Reality N-482, killing its versions of Mira and Selra. After grieving for some time, Veyran Kest N-482 built his own Rift Spindle, the only Veyran other than Oris to actually invent the device and began hunting Veyran Oris.

It is an amazing gun, but has its limits. Only mass heavier than air may pass through the portal.

sources.title: Avor Kel
sources.text:
He explains to Talen that leaving Veyran was a "dick move", and that Veyran really does care about him. Furthermore, if it wasn't for Veyran, he [Avor Kel] would be dead and would never have met Talen. He then recharges the Rift Spindle and sends Talen back to Veyran.

In "Videlu Safalo," it can be noted that Avor Kel and Veyran have been acquainted for years, as there are many picture frames containing Veyran on his wall. During Avor Kel's early adulthood, he, Veyran and Zorvik formed a band called "Sefane Losemi", where Avor Kel was featured as the main singer. Avor Kel can also be seen beside a younger Veyran, and some sort of aircraft.

In "Loneri Deriri", he and Sera get married and have a huge wedding party. During this time, he confessed to Selra that he and Veyran are wanted by the Vhalan Compact for committing "crimes in the name of freedom" which Selra shrugs off. Shortly after, during the reception, Sera reveals herself to be a member of the Vhalan Compact's secret service and shoots Avor Kel multiple times, followed by a shootout with the rest of the criminals in the room.

Sera and the Yavari resurrected Avor Kel as a cyborg and renamed him Avor Ember. Although Sera wanted his name to be Avor Alloy, she didn't push hard enough to make that official. She settled on Avor Ember and took off with him.
